name: Crushing Pressure, Lesser
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 1, bloodrager 1, inquisitor 1, magus 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 5)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You change the pressure of the air around the target causing it to painfully press in upon their body, dealing 1 bludgeoning damage per round at the beginning of their turn. They may make a Fortitude save to negate the damage for the round. This bludgeoning damage is physical and is subject to DR but is considered magic for DR purposes.
